description: This Java class defines an exception named APIAuthenticationException, which extends APIException. It represents errors related to user authentication failures within the OpenMRS API infrastructure, often tied to user privileges and login issues.

classes.name: APIAuthenticationException
classes.description: An exception class indicating authentication errors within the OpenMRS API, often related to user privileges.

methods.description: Default constructor for creating an APIAuthenticationException instance without a message.
